# Robust frequency encoding function that handles NaN and unseen categories
def safe_frequency_encoding(df, col):
    """Safely compute frequency encoding for a column with NaN protection"""
    # Get unique values in training data
    unique_vals = df[col].dropna().value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index()

    # Create mapping dictionary
    freq_map = dict(unique_vals.items())

    # Encode all rows, handling missing values
    encoded = df[col].map(freq_map).fillna(len(unique_vals))
    return encoded
